source.name: Theorems about the definitions of the features of the shape of a series over time, checked by Lean
source.how: each expected value is proved to be the value of the feature's definition at the doubles nearest the stored values, or within half a unit in its last place of it, by the theorem its record names in spec/XtractSpec/Records/Temporal.lean; written by tests/reference/generate/lean_temporal.py and checked by Lean's kernel

tolerance.reason: no rounding: every value is a multiple of 1/4, so each product with an index and each addition is exact, and each of the two divisions gives the quotient itself, which is a double; the expected value is exact

2002 roundings, each within 2^-53 relatively: the product of a value and its index in every term, and the N - 1 additions of those terms, which are of one sign, in any order; the N - 1 additions of the values, of one sign, in any order; the division by their sum; the division by N - 1; and the expected value
